CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${tableName}` ( `id` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `date` DATE DEFAULT NULL, `chart_account_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `location_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `debit` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, `credit` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, `customer_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `vendor_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `employee_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `other_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `class_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `chart_account_id` (`chart_account_id`), KEY `company_id` (`company_id`), KEY `location_id` (`location_id`), KEY `date` (`date`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;

SELECT SUM(debit)-SUM(credit) FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id WHERE is_active=1 AND is_approve=1 AND company_id= 1 AND chart_account_id=#{filter.chartAccountId} AND is_reconcile=1 AND reconcile_id!=#{filter.ReconcileDateId} AND (SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=reconcile_id) <= (SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId})

SELECT gl.id AS id, gld.type AS typeName, cus.id AS customerId, CASE WHEN gld.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(cus.name, '') WHEN gld.vendor_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id=gld.vendor_id) WHEN gld.employee_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM employees WHERE id=gld.employee_id) WHEN gld.other_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM others WHERE id=gld.employee_id) ELSE "" END AS customerName, gl.date AS date, gl.reference AS reference, gld.is_reconcile AS clear, (gld.credit*-1) AS amount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id LEFT JOIN customers AS cus ON cus.id = gld.customer_id WHERE credit>0 AND gl.is_active=1 AND gl.is_approve=1 AND gld.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND gld.chart_account_id=#{filter.chartAccountId} AND ( gld. reconcile_id IS NULL OR ( gld.is_reconcile=1 AND gld.reconcile_id!=#{filter.ReconcileDateId} AND date<(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) AND (SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=reconcile_id)>(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) ) ) AND date>(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) ORDER BY date ASC, gl.id ASC

SELECT gl.id AS id, gld.type AS typeName, cus.id AS customerId, CASE WHEN gld.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(cus.name, '') WHEN gld.vendor_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id=gld.vendor_id) WHEN gld.employee_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM employees WHERE id=gld.employee_id) WHEN gld.other_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM others WHERE id=gld.employee_id) ELSE "" END AS customerName, gl.date AS date, gl.reference AS reference, gld.is_reconcile AS clear, (gld.credit*-1) AS amount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id LEFT JOIN customers AS cus ON cus.id = gld.customer_id WHERE credit>0 AND gl.is_active=1 AND gl.is_approve=1 AND gld.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND gld.chart_account_id=#{filter.chartAccountId} AND ( gld. reconcile_id IS NULL OR ( gld.is_reconcile=1 AND gld.reconcile_id!=#{filter.ReconcileDateId} AND date<(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) AND (SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=reconcile_id)>(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) ) ) AND date <= (SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) ORDER BY date ASC, gl.id ASC

SELECT gl.id AS id, gld.type AS typeName, cus.id AS customerId, CASE WHEN gld.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(cus.customer_code, '-', cus.name) WHEN gld.vendor_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id=gld.vendor_id) WHEN gld.employee_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM employees WHERE id=gld.employee_id) WHEN gld.other_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT name FROM others WHERE id=gld.employee_id) ELSE "" END AS customerName, gl.date AS date, gl.reference AS reference, gld.is_reconcile AS clear, (gld.debit) AS amount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id LEFT JOIN customers AS cus ON cus.id = gld.customer_id WHERE debit>0 AND gl.is_active=1 AND gl.is_approve=1 AND gld.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND gld.chart_account_id=#{filter.chartAccountId} AND ( gld. reconcile_id IS NULL OR ( gld.is_reconcile=1 AND gld.reconcile_id!=#{filter.ReconcileDateId} AND date<(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) AND (SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=reconcile_id)>(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) ) ) AND date>(SELECT date FROM reconciles WHERE id=#{filter.ReconcileDateId}) ORDER BY date ASC, gl.id ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(#{date}), '-', MONTH(#{date}), '-01') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(debit) - SUM(debit), 0) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(debit), 0) AS debit, IFNULL(SUM(credit), 0) AS credit FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id = gld.general_ledger_id WHERE gld.chart_account_id = #{chartAccountId} AND gl.is_approve = 1 AND gl.is_active = 1 AND (YEAR(gl.date) = YEAR(#{date}) AND MONTH(gl.date) = MONTH(#{date}))

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(#{date}), '-', MONTH(#{date}), '-01') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(debit) - SUM(credit), 0) AS totalAmount, SUM(debit) AS debit, SUM(credit) AS credit FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id = gld.general_ledger_id WHERE gld.chart_account_id IN (SELECT id FROM chart_accounts WHERE chart_account_group_id = #{chartAccountId}) AND gl.is_approve = 1 AND gl.is_active = 1 AND ( YEAR(gl.date) < YEAR(#{date}) OR (YEAR(gl.date) = YEAR(#{date}) AND MONTH(gl.date) < MONTH(#{date})) )
